title: Compose Multiplatform with Supabase
description: Share most Android and iOS UI with Compose Multiplatform and use Supabase Auth and managed backend services.

modules.responsibility: Android application entry, Activity, manifest, variants, and signing; depends on composeApp.
Xcode project and minimal Swift bootstrap into Kotlin; product UI and lifecycle behavior stay in composeApp.
Shared Compose root, client composition, and iOS framework target.
Shared client contracts and network, storage, and platform adapters.
Feature contracts, state, and client behavior organized by capability.
Supabase project configuration, database migrations, RLS policies, and Edge Functions; credentials are provisioned outside tracked files.
